I have been bringing my dog here for years, and there service was great
However recently there service has been bad. The last couple of times it doesn't seem like they wash my dogs face. They leave the tear residue around her face, and claim that it does not come off, however when I bathe her at home I am able to take that off. The owner is raising his prices, which is understandable because of inflation but there is no reason why his service should be bad. I was very disappointed when I picked up my dog today, amd was just told I can clean it with a wipe. Will be looking for another groomer with better service.
